prompt: Research the top five AI wallet companies and compare their products, pricing, strengths, and weaknesses.

deliverable.title: Research 5 AI wallet companies

findings.name: Trust Wallet
findings.summary: Leading multi-chain self-custody wallet equipped with an AI Security Scanner that proactively detects malicious smart contracts, phishing dApps, and zero-day transfer risks.
findings.pricing: Free self-custody software; standard on-chain blockchain gas fees apply.
findings.strengths: 140M+ users, support for 100+ blockchains, real-time AI smart contract risk analysis, and seamless Web3 dApp connectivity.
findings.weaknesses: Broad multi-chain footprint requires user diligence for custom RPCs; does not perform autonomous trade execution.

findings.name: Dawn Wallet
findings.summary: AI-native smart contract wallet purpose-built for autonomous transaction simulation, intent-based natural language execution, and ERC-4337 account abstraction.
findings.pricing: Free consumer self-custody; optional developer API tiers and gas sponsorship via paymasters.
findings.strengths: Converts natural language user prompts into validated multi-step on-chain transactions with pre-execution safety simulation.
findings.weaknesses: Emerging ecosystem currently focused primarily on EVM networks; complex multi-hop routes require explicit intent confirmation.

findings.name: Coin98 AI Wallet
findings.summary: Comprehensive multi-chain Web3 wallet integrating Cypheus AI Assistant for automated cross-chain routing, portfolio rebalancing alerts, and token contract verification.
findings.pricing: Free consumer download; standard network gas fees and optional cross-chain bridge fees.
findings.strengths: Native integration across 90+ blockchains, intelligent DEX route aggregation, and built-in AI assistant for on-chain asset insights.
findings.weaknesses: Feature-dense interface can have a learning curve; AI assistant operates primarily in advisory mode rather than autonomous execution.

findings.name: Safe (Safe{Core} AI)
findings.summary: Industry-standard smart account infrastructure powering multi-signature security and programmable account modules for automated AI agents and institutional treasuries.
products: Safe{Core} SDK & AI Agent Guardrail Modules
findings.pricing: Open source protocol; free contract deployment (on-chain gas only); enterprise support plans available.
findings.strengths: Secures over $100B in digital assets; robust permission modules and spending limits specifically tailored for autonomous agent execution.
findings.weaknesses: Requires initial smart contract deployment transaction on each network; multi-sig approvals can slow down instant transactions.

findings.name: Privy / Biconomy Smart Accounts
findings.summary: Developer-first embedded wallet platform enabling AI agent automation via ERC-4337 smart accounts, programmable session keys, and gasless transaction sponsorship.
findings.pricing: Developer freemium tier; usage-based monthly active user (MAU) and bundler transaction pricing.
findings.strengths: Enables AI agents to execute transactions autonomously within user-defined session parameters without repeatedly prompting for signatures.
findings.weaknesses: Infrastructure-focused platform designed for application embedding rather than a standalone consumer app.
